links.comparator_used: ChatGPT-5.1 recommendations shown alone, with no accuracy or confidence information
links.outcome: Physician diagnostic reasoning score against an expert rubric, scored by blinded reviewers, in vignettes where 3 of 6 contained deliberate errors
links.effect: Mean difference 7.6 percentage points higher in the nudge arm; 95% CI 1.4-13.9; P=0.016
links.quote: The treatment group scored significantly higher (mean difference, 7.6 percentage-points; 95% CI, 1.4-13.9;  P =0.016) than the control, suggesting a scalable strategy to preserve clinical judgment in LLM-assisted care.
